convert_to_latitude_longitude.description: Turn an easting and northing on a Swiss grid, from a land register, a plan or a cantonal dataset, into latitude and longitude for any map. Reads the current LV95 grid and the older LV03 one, telling them apart by their size, and gives LV95 for both. Exact to a few centimetres, from swisstopo's official conversion service.

description: Look up Switzerland's official places, addresses and map data from swisstopo, the Federal Office of Topography, through the federal geoportal geo.admin.ch. Find any address, postcode, municipality, canton, land parcel or name on the national map with its coordinates; find out which municipality, canton, postcode, parcel and building a point lies in; look up features on about 900 official map layers, from the building register to protected areas and noise maps; get the height of any point and an elevation profile along a line; and convert between latitude and longitude and the Swiss LV95 and LV03 grids. Every action reads: nothing here changes anything. No account or API key required.
